Flow.description: ALF-RS-04: per-item counterpart of AF_FL_Appraisal_ApprovalRequested (which is itself Draft/inactive in this org - the Appraisal-level approval-requested notification is instead handled by AF_FL_Appraisal_EvaluationSubmit's Custom Notification loop). Kept Draft to match its Appraisal-level template exactly (that flow was never activated - AF_FL_AppraisalItem_EvaluationSubmit already sends the approval-requested Custom Notification to the queue for the per-item flow, same as its Appraisal-level counterpart does). Present for structural parity / future activation if the business asks for a manager-style email notification later, mirroring AF_FL_Appraisal_ApprovalRequested's shape exactly (Owner/Manager lookup chain), retargeted to AppraisalItem via a Get_Appraisal hop for Contact/Rep fields that only exist on the parent.
Flow.label: Appraisal Item Approval Requested
